name: penny
description: Penny, a personal budget manager: payments, recurring items, installments and forecasts

scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: cd server && npm test && cd ../client && npm test
scripts.e2e: cd e2e && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run ui
